findings.message: DSpace Institutional Repository returned a DOI/handle/accession that does not match the export request.
findings.action: Do not mark the export complete until the repository record points at the intended identifier.

findings.message: DSpace Institutional Repository indexed a different project version than the submitted package.
findings.action: Reconcile the repository record or redeposit the exact version before reporting compliance.

findings.message: DSpace Institutional Repository received a file whose checksum differs from the submitted package.
findings.action: Hold publication credit until the repository file is replaced or the package version is corrected.

findings.message: DSpace Institutional Repository receipt is missing a required artifact.
findings.action: Re-run the export package and verify that every required artifact appears in the deposit manifest.

findings.message: DSpace Institutional Repository preserved the contributor but dropped one or more CRediT roles.
findings.action: Patch the repository metadata so contributor credit remains auditable.

findings.message: DSpace Institutional Repository did not preserve a required contributor ORCID.
findings.action: Update repository metadata before the institutional profile or ORCID sync is marked complete.

findings.message: DSpace Institutional Repository metadata does not preserve the submitted license.
findings.action: Correct the repository license field before downstream reuse or compliance export.

findings.message: DSpace Institutional Repository access status does not match the institutional export policy.
findings.action: Do not certify the export until access, embargo, or restricted-data policy is reconciled.

findings.message: DSpace Institutional Repository embargo ends after the funder open-access deadline.
findings.action: Escalate to the institutional compliance owner before reporting funder compliance.

findings.message: DSpace Institutional Repository is missing required metadata standards for enterprise export reconciliation.
findings.action: Patch the repository metadata before syncing the record to institutional dashboards.

findings.message: DSpace Institutional Repository webhook acknowledgement failed signature validation.
findings.action: Treat the acknowledgement as untrusted and require a signed replay or API poll.

findings.message: InvenioRDM accepted the package but has not confirmed indexing yet.
findings.action: Keep the export in follow-up until the indexing webhook or poll result arrives.

findings.message: InvenioRDM is missing required metadata standards for enterprise export reconciliation.

findings.message: InvenioRDM has no webhook acknowledgement for the expected export event.
findings.action: Poll the repository or replay the webhook before closing the enterprise export task.
